main.description: A short-form video post. The record holds portable canonical metadata and a reference to the uploaded video blob; transcoded renditions (HLS) are derived by the media pipeline and are not part of the record.

video.description: The source video as uploaded by the author.

caption.description: Author-written caption shown with the video.

tags.description: Hashtags without the leading '#', used for discovery.

durationMs.description: Duration of the video in milliseconds, as measured by the client at upload time.

thumbnail.description: Poster image displayed before playback starts.

alt.description: Alt text describing the video for accessibility.

langs.description: Languages spoken or captioned in the video, as BCP-47 tags.

labels.description: Self-applied labels, for example adult content markers.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when the post was created.

aspectRatio.description: Display aspect ratio as a width:height pair. Only the ratio is meaningful; the values are not pixel dimensions.
